goal: Stop the 'Kip echo' mechanism in UniversalConversation.tsx from creating a new, dialog-less kip_session every time it fails to find an exact-name match. Archive the existing orphaned sessions this has already created.
notes: Root cause: createSession called with board/frame instead of dialogBoard/dialogFrame. Effect is now resume-only; create via resumeOrCreateBoardSession at first echo. kip_sessions.is_archived + archive-orphan-echo-sessions.ts (dry-run default).
